name: OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications
description: Authoritative list of the most critical security vulnerabilities found in large language model applications, providing developers, architects, and CISOs with actionable mitigation guidance.
applicability_conditions: Any software system utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs) or foundation models

requirements.title: Prompt Injection
requirements.normalized_requirement: The organization shall protect the application against prompt injections (direct jailbreaks and indirect injections via external data sources) by enforcing input validation, context separation, privileged tool constraints, and output verification.
requirements.implementation_guidance: Employ prompt sanitization, demarcate untrusted content, and constrain agent permissions.

requirements.title: Sensitive Information Disclosure
requirements.normalized_requirement: The organization shall prevent the exposure of PII, proprietary source code, secrets, or confidential business data in LLM outputs through pre-training/fine-tuning sanitization, RAG access controls, and real-time egress filtering.
requirements.applicability: All LLM applications handling sensitive data
requirements.implementation_guidance: Deploy automated PII redaction and DLP filters on LLM inputs and responses.

requirements.title: Supply Chain Vulnerabilities
requirements.normalized_requirement: The organization shall audit and verify the integrity and origin of third-party models, weights, datasets, plugins, and libraries using cryptographically signed hashes and trusted registries.
requirements.applicability: AI systems consuming external models or datasets
requirements.implementation_guidance: Enforce model signature verification and scan Python/ML dependencies for known CVEs.
evidence_expected: AI Supply Chain Integrity Verification Log

requirements.title: Data and Model Poisoning
requirements.normalized_requirement: The organization shall prevent malicious manipulation of training data, fine-tuning datasets, or vector embeddings that introduce backdoors or bias.
requirements.applicability: Trained, fine-tuned, or RAG-based AI systems
requirements.implementation_guidance: Validate data sources, compute data integrity hashes, and conduct data anomaly detection.

requirements.title: Improper Output Handling
requirements.normalized_requirement: The organization shall treat LLM outputs as untrusted and perform strict validation and sanitization prior to passing outputs to downstream components, databases, or browsers to prevent XSS, SSRF, or SQL injection.
requirements.applicability: All LLM applications integrated into applications
requirements.implementation_guidance: Sanitize and encode all model outputs before rendering or executing database queries.

requirements.title: Excessive Agency
requirements.normalized_requirement: The organization shall restrict the autonomy and permissions granted to LLMs and AI agents, adhering to the principle of least privilege, requiring human confirmation for sensitive operations, and rate-limiting actions.
requirements.implementation_guidance: Enforce tool permission boundaries and mandatory human-in-the-loop approval gates for destructive actions.
